digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter resilience and config validation
propositions: Cloud transport members lack enumerated per-member 429-retry coverage at all four dispatch/seam boundaries (pooled-REST direct, bare-urlopen, subprocess, dispatch-wrapped), risking silent retry-path inheritance and duplicate-write bugs
Cloud config validation does not reject non-HTTPS base URLs and does not fail loudly on missing credentials, unlike DC, creating parity gaps introduced by bug cd78 shape

Cloud probe hardcodes resolved-status names without runtime configurability (DC threads from settings), requiring decision on whether a config hook is needed for deployments with non-standard workflow states
DC user-search method degradation is unasserted and could silently regress if method aliases are accidentally renamed on the Cloud side

Mutations across Cloud's four distinct 429-behavior layers (direct REST no-retry, subprocess backoff, dispatch-wrapper retry, non-retrying apply-phases) require per-layer attempt-count assertions and duplicate-write-safety documentation at each boundary
